v: Small indie movie, but the screenplay kept me hooked 👍 Cast has limits, budget shows... still the passion and content easily make it worth a watch.
e: Lovers’ Love Stori takes a risky non-linear approach, beginning close to the pre-climax and then gradually revealing its characters’ backstories. Directors Vempati Srenivas and Venugopal Makala make that structure work surprisingly well, with Dhruvan Katakam providing the strongest emotional connection despite the film’s obvious production limitations.
body:
Where to Watch : Youtube, MX Player, Hungama Play, Airtel Xstream, VI

Link : https://youtu.be/kkZNQz44gGg

Good Content and Good Screenplay!!! its never easy to start the movie at Pre-Climax part and then later start revealing the back stories especially for non thriller movies as most of the audience will start loosing intrest in whats happening on the screen and try to pre process what the climax would be!!! However with this screenplay the Directors duo of Vempati Srenivas & Venugopal Makala had made sure that to glue the audience to the current proceedings on the screen.

Vempati Srenivas & Venugopal Makala have Produced, Directed and have written Dialogues for this movie which shows their passion….

Acting wise Dhruvan katakam did a fantastic job and his character is what we instantly gets connected to. All other actors did okay considering their own limitations, Any famous/good star cast from short movies industry would have elevated the content to next level.

BGM and Song Lyrics were inline with the story and with in their limitations no where deviated from what is required. All the departments did apt job.

v: GOOD idea, weak execution 😞 First half drags, second half finally gives the emotion. Vennela Kishore’s regret track hit me the hardest... aa guilt trip vere level 😢
e: Oke Oka Jeevitham has a beautiful emotional idea about regret, missed choices and the temptation to revisit the past, but the execution never feels as strong as the writing deserves. The first half is slow and the music adds little, while Vennela Kishore, Priyadarshi and the nostalgic details help the second half become the real soul of the film.
body:
GOOD Content BAD Execution!!!

Story wise people with Low Confidence, people who have guilt on their past career and personal choices will definitely connect to this movie…and for others it may be Okay Okay Types Story!!! Execution wise though you will not be sure where exactly it went wrong it could have been handled much better!!!! Songs and BGM are just okay and are actually a minus!!!

The Star attraction actually turned out to be huge minus due to her lack of acting abilities!!! The introduction shot of Amala Akkineni is a small tribute to her efforts towards Blue Cross and shows how much the director really wanted to cast her. Amala Akkineni though has been the main attraction her limitations in Acting was clearly visible, and I felt that it was a set back to hype the emotional depth to the Mother-Son scenes which where otherwise excellently written!!!!

Though Sharwanand is the hero and Darshi and Vennala Kishore played equally key roles….yet content wise Kishore’s characterisation is what we connect to the most and man he makes us most of us take the guilt trip back the memory about our study choices 😢 and also Darshi’s characterisation takes us back to the memories of all our school crushes 😍

Though first half tries to set the tone of the film not sure why it felt bit slow and lagging 🤷🏻‍♂️ all through the first half of the movie you will those small yet memorable Nostalgic moments at regular intervals throughout the first half…….Second half is the Soul and Saving grace of this movie!!!

v: Apparently I watched a different Brahmāstra from the internet 😂 I liked the content and franchise idea... graphicsే నాకు biggest complaint. Watch it and decide for yourself.
e: Brahmāstra worked for me very differently from many of the reviews I read after the show. I enjoyed the mythology-inspired content, Ayan Mukerji’s ambition and the cast, while the VFX — widely praised elsewhere — was actually the element I found least convincing. It is a divisive film, but one I was happy to watch again.
body:
Personally I loved the movie….it had Good Content + Great Visualisation (from Directors perspective) + Great Star Cast + Excellent Acting

Poor Graphics is the only minus in this movie which other wise would had been a GREAT WATCH!!!

The only thing I couldn’t understand was the concept of Hero getting Fire ignited when Heroine is around!!! Vaadu em fire gurunchi matladuthunado 😉

I watched the 9:30 show and when I read reviews post movie I was shocked to see all the reviews being complete opposite to what I have experienced while watching movie. They say the Graphics were Great but the content was let down 🤷🏻‍♂️ For a minute I thought was I different from the lot and had to take time to introspect my movie watching experience but still I felt the same, It had very good content for the type if story they selected and have the potential of a Franchise based film similar to Krish. I had to crosscheck with my friend who watched it along with me and he also had similar opinion to mine.

Finally I conclude that this movie caters to different audience in different ways and you must watch it to have your own experience. I would be definitely watching it for the second time for my daughter. Kids will love it.

PS : No-onefrom cini industry cares that I exist hence there is no point in them bribing me to give positive review. So consider this as my genuine experience and it may differ from yours based on our tastes 😉

v: DISASTER!!!! 😭 Puri went Pan-India and somehow forgot the Puri-ness itself. No kickass character, no dialogue fire... Ramya Krishna alone trying to save the damage.
e: Liger is frustrating because Puri Jagannadh’s films have often survived weak plots through explosive characterisation and sharp dialogue. Here, the Pan-India ambition strips away exactly those strengths, leaving an old-school masala structure without the attitude that once made his formula entertaining.
body:
Disaster!!!! Poori & Devarakonda kalisi Karan Johar gadi ni De…De..De…Debesesaru!!

Everyone knows that Puri is very weak with his stories and its only his kickass characterisations and their kickass dialogues which give that much needed kick to audience!!! and much to my dismay thats exactly what missing in this movie….You expect some ultimate high octane dialogues from Puri’s hero, but when the hero stammers there is no scope for him to deliver basic stuff forget about Puri’s trade mark dialogues 😞

In the quest to go Pan India….Puri just ditched his strength which has been his only saving grace all these years!!!

Ananya Pandey was at her annoying best…Ramya Krishna was the only saving grace

Being a huge fan of Puri Jaganadh’s hard hitting dialogues….I was very keen to see how Liger fares especially in the times where any movie with content is being a Blockbuster and Normal Masala movies being outrightly rejected!!! and till #ismartShankar Puri was struck in the same old formula and this movie being made on grand pan indian scale was curious how things would turn out….and it Puri made it worse by sticking to his old rotten masala format minus his trademark style dialogues
